nodes.name: NF pretreatment
nodes.procedure: Firstly, the NF was rinsed with acetone for several times, followed by sonicated in 1.0 M HCl for 30 min.
nodes.source_text: Firstly, the NF was rinsed with acetone for several times, followed by sonicated in 1.0 M HCl for 30 min.

nodes.name: Hydrothermal synthesis of NiMoO4/NF
nodes.procedure: Secondly, it was immersed into a Teflon-lined stainless steel autoclave containing a mixture solution of Ni(NO3)2·6H2O, CO(NH2)2, (NH4)6Mo7O24·4H2O, and ethylene glycol. Subsequently, it was heated at 120°C in a drying oven for 12 h. After cooled down to room temperature, they were washed with deionized water and absolute ethanol for several times and dried at 60°C overnight under vacuum. The obtained sample was referred to NiMoO4/NF nanosheets.

nodes.characterization_summary: N2 adsorption/desorption at 77K confirms meso/macroporous structure (see Fig. S3 and Table S1).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The N₂ adsorption/desorption of Ni@C-MoO₂/NF were analysed with an ASAP 2420 (Micrometeritics Co., USA) at 77K... which is tested by BET (Fig. S3 and Table S1).

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD shows characteristic peaks of Ni at 44.5°(111), 51.8°(200), 76.4°(220) and MoO2 at 26.1°(011), 36.8°(200) for Ni@C-MoO2/NF annealed at 450°C.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. S4a displays the XRD pattern of Ni@C - MoO2 / NF , in which five characteristic peaks located at 44.5°(111) , 51.8°(200) , 76.4°(220) , 26.1°(011) , and 36.8°(200) can be indexed to Ni(PDF#04 - 0850) and MoO2(PDF#65 - 5787) at 450°C.

nodes.characterization_summary: Raman confirms formation of N-doped-graphene layer catalyzed by Ni atoms.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the Ni atoms simultaneously catalyze the covered carbon to form an N-doped-graphene layer, which is confirmed by Raman (Fig. S4c).

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM shows graphene encapsulated Ni particles anchored on MoO2 nanosheets; Ni (111) lattice spacing 0.207 nm, carbon layer thickness ~1.163 nm, MoO2 (200) 0.240 nm and (011) 0.350 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: TEM and HRTEM images (Fig. 2a) show that the graphene encapsulated Ni particles are evenly anchored onto the surface of MoO2 nanosheets in Ni@C-MoO2/NF . The lattice spacing of 0.207 nm belongs to the (111) crystal plane of Ni(PDF#04-0850), and the thickness of the encapsulated carbon layer on the Ni particle is ∼1.163nm (Fig. 2b)... The lattice fringes with the interplanar distances of 0.240 and 0.350 nm are assigned to the (200) and (011) facets of MoO2(PDF#65-5787) (Fig. 2c).

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni 2p shows red-shift in binding energy indicating electron interaction between Ni and N-doped-graphene; N 1s pyridinic-N at 398.4 eV; C 1s peaks at 284.8 eV (C-C), 286.4 eV (C-N), 288.6 eV (C=O); Mo 3d shows Mo6+ 235.5/232.4 eV, Mo5+ 233.5/230.4 eV, Mo4+ 232.5/229.4 eV.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In Fig. 3a, the high-resolution Ni 2p spectra in Ni@C-MoO2/NF has a red-shift of binding energy (BE) relative to that in Ni-MoO2/NF (Table S2)... the N 1s region of Ni@C-MoO2/NF exhibited a strong peak at 398.4 eV , which is due to the pyridinic-N... The peaks at 284.8, 288.6, and 286.4 eV are ascribed to C-C, C=O, and C-N bonds (Fig. 3c)... Fig. 3d shows the Mo 3d of Ni@C-MoO2/ NF, in which the peaks at 235.5, 233.5, 232.5, 232.4, 230.4 and 229.4 eV are attributed to the Mo6+ 3d3/2 , Mo5+ 3d3/2 , Mo4+ 3d3/2 , Mo6+ 3d5/2 , Mo5+ 3d5/2 , and Mo4+ 3d5/2 , respectively.
